author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Golf flag (pole + triangular pennant) planted in a smooth oval green that opens around the pole like the reference; reads as a golf hole at 48 in both themes, no longer as a boxy S-bracket.
omissions: The small notch where the reference's two green lobes meet is smoothed into one outline; the short grass stroke right of the pole merges into the green's end.
